setup: A whole number is being combined with a fraction.

steps.say: The whole number [[w]] is worth [[w]] full units, and each unit can be written over the denominator.
Every whole contributes [[b]]/[[b]], so the denominator [[b]] stays the same while the count of parts grows.
Adding the whole part to the fractional part means counting all the parts over that one denominator.
